hero.subtitle: Record your activities, hours, output and absences as you work. At the end of the month, Alveryn gives you a clear record to review against your payslip.

productPages.ctaTitle: Ready to make your own record?

dashboardTour.title: Everything important, before your first scroll.
dashboardTour.body: Dashboard connects today’s work with the week around it. Every card answers one useful question.

day.title: What did today add to your week?
day.body: See today’s hours and earnings beside the weekly flow, daily average, gross total and extra amount.

activity.title: Where did those numbers come from?
activity.body: Every activity keeps its schedule, duration, work type and calculated earnings together.

rhythm.title: Is your week balanced?
rhythm.body: Compare daily hours with your normal rhythm and see worked time and extra time instantly.

calendarTour.title: A month you can actually read.
calendarTour.body: Calendar turns every workday, payment and document into one connected monthly story.

month.title: Every day has context.
month.body: Spot workdays, rest days, hours, earnings and vacation without opening each entry.

summary.title: The answer at the end of the month.
summary.body: Gross, hours, days, absences and extra pay stay in one compact balance.

payroll.title: Alveryn and Lohn, line by line.
payroll.body: Compare worked hours, extra pay and gross, then inspect the items extracted from Lohn.

flow.title: See how income moved.
flow.body: Daily earnings reveal strong days, gaps and the month’s real average.

rhythm.title: See how your time moved.
rhythm.body: Daily hours make workload and unusual days visible at a glance.

tools.title: Bring it in. Take it with you.
tools.body: Import historical work and export a clear PDF whenever you need to share it.

statisticsTour.title: Numbers that answer back.
statisticsTour.body: Choose the question, see the trend and compare the answer across any period.

filters.title: Ask exactly what you want to know.
filters.body: Switch between week, month, year or a custom range, then choose the value that matters.

trend.title: The big picture and the facts beneath it.
trend.body: Follow gross income over time, then read hours, worked days, entries and daily average together.

compare.title: Put two periods on the same scale.
compare.body: Current, previous and change stay aligned so a difference is immediately understandable.

selected.title: Zoom into the moment that changed the curve.
selected.body: Select any day or month to reveal both values and the exact difference at that point.

capabilities.title: From a complicated workday to a clear answer.
capabilities.body: Record the work once. Alveryn keeps the calculation rules and the history organized for you.

items.title: Record work your way
items.description: Enter a time interval, completed units or fixed-price work. Group related work types and keep different activities in the same day.

items.title: Calculate what the work means
items.description: Connect rates and payment models to your work. Alveryn turns time and output into understandable hours and earnings.

items.title: Review the complete picture
items.description: See workdays, absences, hours and calculated earnings together instead of rebuilding the month from notes and spreadsheets.

workflow.title: Configure once. Record in seconds. Review anytime.
workflow.body: Alveryn adapts to the rules of your work, then keeps everyday tracking focused.

steps.title: Describe how you work
steps.description: Add your employment, choose how you are paid and create the work types you perform.

steps.title: Record each working day
steps.description: Select an activity and manually enter its time, units or completed work in seconds.

steps.title: Use the history
steps.description: Review the calendar, absences and totals without calculating everything again.

audience.title: One app when work is more than one simple shift.
audience.body: Alveryn is useful when hours, output and payment do not fit neatly into a basic timer.

items.title: Hourly workers
items.description: Keep an independent history of shifts, breaks, overtime context and absences.

items.title: Multi-job workers
items.description: Separate jobs, work types and rates without splitting your history across different tools.

items.title: Output-based work
items.description: Track rooms, deliveries, pieces, kilometres or completed jobs alongside time.
